articles.summary: Combined company to operate as Korsana Biosciences and to advance Korsana’s potential best-in-class therapeutics to treat neurodegenerative diseases Korsana’s lead program KRSA-028 is a next-generation shuttled monoclonal antibody targeting amyloid beta for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease
articles.title: Cyclerion Therapeutics and Korsana Biosciences Announce Merger Agreement
